_meta.description: BFB 气化炉模型验证工况数据集 — 来自 Hamel (1999) Chapter 7 & 8
_meta.source: Hamel S (1999) Mathematische Modellierung und experimentelle Untersuchung der Vergasung verschiedener fester Brennstoffe in atmosphärischen und druckaufgeladenen stationären Wirbelschichten
notes: 出口气组成为 dry basis mol/mol（模拟值，从原文 Fig 读取）
'__MISSING__' 标记需要从论文表格或图形中补充提取的数据
'__FROM_PLOT__' 标记从论文图形近似读数、精度 ±5-10%
'__CALCULATED__' 标记需反推计算的参数

validation_performance_summary.notes: Coal 工况精度最高；Peat 无颗粒循环时碳转化率偏高；CH4 偏高归因于二次焦油裂解建模不足

CASE_HTW_WESSELING_1._comment: HTW 加压中试炉 (Wesseling), Air/Steam 工况, Hamel (1999) Simulation Nr.1

inputs.heat_loss_note: ~5-10% of thermal input for pilot plant

exit_gas_dry_mol_frac.N2: __CALCULATED__  (balance, ~0.44 for air case on wet basis)
exit_gas_dry_mol_frac._note: exit dry fracs: CO≈0.157, CO2≈0.133, H2≈0.145, CH4≈0.034 (after removing H2O)

axial_profiles._coordinate: Normierte Höhe ξ: 0-0.3 conical entry, 0.3-0.5 stationary bed, 0.5-1.0 freeboard

_observations.O2_primary: O2 consumed within first 15% height; drives T rise to ~1100 K
_observations.O2_secondary: Secondary air injection at ξ≈0.6 causes O2 spike to 0.012 and T spike to 1240 K
_observations.T_dip: Endothermic gasification (R2 C+H2O, R4 C+CO2) causes T drop from 1100→1060 K in ξ=0.2-0.45
_observations.T_spike: Secondary air combustion raises T by ~200 K at ξ≈0.6
_observations.CO_H2_dip: CO and H2 drop at ξ≈0.6 due to partial combustion, then recover via WGS equilibration
_observations.CH4_flat: CH4 stays flat ~0.025 through freeboard — minimal secondary formation/destruction
_observations.H2O_trend: Highest consumption in first 30% where devolatilization + char gasification are most intense

CASE_HTW_WESSELING_2._comment: HTW 加压中试炉 (Wesseling), O2/Steam 工况, Hamel (1999) Simulation Nr.2

gasification_agent.steam_flow_kg_h: __MISSING__  (cannot derive from λ_O2; need Table 7.1 steam column)

inputs.heat_loss_note: ~5-10% of thermal input for pilot plant

outputs.exit_temperature_note: model predicts faster T decay in upper freeboard than measured

exit_gas_wet_mol_frac.N2: __CALCULATED__  (balance, very low for O2/steam case — near zero)

axial_profiles._coordinate: Normierte Höhe ξ: 0-0.3 conical entry, 0.3-0.5 stationary bed, 0.5-1.0 freeboard

_observations.no_N2_dilution: O2/steam case — no N2 dilution → CO/H2 nearly double vs air case (0.335 vs 0.130)
_observations.T_peak: Secondary O2 peak at ξ≈0.6 reaches 1380 K (vs 1240 K in air case)
_observations.CO2_spike: Sharp CO2 increase at ξ≈0.6 from partial combustion of CO/H2
_observations.CH4_higher: CH4 ~0.048 (vs 0.028 in air) — enhanced secondary cracking in hotter freeboard
_observations.H2O_consumption: H2O drops from 0.38 (entry) to 0.17 (exit) — steam consumed by gasification + WGS

CASE_HTW_BERRENRATH._comment: HTW 示范工厂 (Berrenrath), 甲醇合成气, Hamel (1999) Simulation Nr.3

gasification_agent.steam_flow_kg_h: __MISSING__  (cannot derive from λ_O2; need Table 7.1 steam column)

outputs.exit_temperature_note: model predicts slightly lower T_exit than measured — actual heat losses lower than modeled at demo scale

axial_profiles._coordinate: Normierte Höhe ξ: 0-0.5 bed region, 0.5 main injection point, 0.5-1.0 freeboard
axial_profiles._note: 23m industrial scale — smoother profiles than pilot plant, injection at ξ≈0.5

_observations.scale_effect: 23m demo: smoother profiles, less extreme T peaks vs 14.5m pilot — better thermal stability
_observations.injection_at_05: Main fuel/agent injection at ξ≈0.5 causes O2 spike to 0.010 and T peak of 1250 K
_observations.O2_persistence: O2 stays >0 for ~15% of height after injection — models combustion zone where devol products are oxidized
_observations.WGS_equilibrium: CO≈0.285, H2≈0.255 at exit — close to WGS equilibrium
_observations.T_decay: T drops 1250→1050 K in freeboard; model slightly underestimates vs measurement

CASE_VTT_PRESSURIZED_COAL_1._comment: VTT 加压 BFB (Finland), 褐煤 Case Nr.1, Hamel (1999)

fuel.type: Brown Coal (Braunkohle) — same reactor as peat cases
fuel._note: Cases 1–4 in Table 7.2 used Brown Coal; fuel analysis likely same as HTW Rhenish coal

gasification_agent._note: exact flows for Case 1 not extracted yet

axial_profiles._coordinate: Normierte Höhe ξ: 0-0.3 bed, 0.3-1.0 freeboard (3.5m reactor)

_observations.sharp_gradients: 3.5m reactor → very sharp concentration changes in bottom 15% of height
_observations.no_secondary_air: No secondary injection for coal case — monotonic T decay in freeboard
_observations.T_profile: T peaks at 1180 K in bed, decays to 980 K at exit
_observations.validation: model captures CO and H2 within ±5-8% for this pressurized coal case

_observations.high_moisture: H2O starts at 0.28 (vs 0.16 for coal) — suppresses bed T by ~100 K
_observations.secondary_air: Secondary air at ξ≈0.6 causes T spike to 1200 K and CO/H2 dip (partial combustion)
_observations.CO2_higher: Exit CO2=0.14 vs 0.105 for coal — due to higher O in peat structure + enhanced WGS

_comparison_with_coal_case1.CO_exit: 0.110 vs 0.160 (peat lower due to dilution + higher WGS)
_comparison_with_coal_case1.T_bed_peak: 1080 vs 1180 K (peat ~100K lower due to moisture)
